name: save-boot-20c-world-menu-state
description: #226 attempt 3 diagnostic: what one Triangle press does on the world map, given time. Load disc1-wm1-kalm and close the entry window as save-boot-20a does, mark "pre", one Triangle press (4 frames), 600 frames still, one Up (4 frames), 60 frames still. Reported at the end: g_GameState (game_state: 5 if the menu module took over), the world loop state (wl_state) and the sign of its change since "pre" (wl_dir: 1 if it was below its end value before the Triangle), the world button flag (btn_ok), the main-menu cursor (row0: 9 if Up moved it from 0) and the menu overlay id (menu_ovl). match: a rerun from the same snapshot. Only numbers leave.
